title: Alert annotation Tag column value length must match DB column width
answers: Why is my alert label/folder path being dropped from the annotation tags?
How long can an annotation tag value be before it's skipped?
Changing the annotation tag value max length
Tag column truncation for alert history
body:
Symptom: a label value (e.g. grafana_folder path) used as an annotation tag silently disappears from alert state-history annotations instead of being saved.
Root cause: convertLabelsToTags/convertLabelsToTagsWithLogger in pkg/services/ngalert/state/historian/annotation.go enforce annotationTagValueColumnMaxLength as a hard cutoff before saving, independent of the actual DB column width.
Fix pattern: when the underlying annotation_tag value column width changes (DB migration), bump annotationTagValueColumnMaxLength to match (currently 512, previously 100) so values aren't rejected below what the column can actually store.
Constraints: this constant must stay in sync with the real DB column size - raising it without a corresponding schema migration will cause DB insert/truncation failures; lowering it without need causes avoidable data loss. Key length limit (annotationTagKeyColumnMaxLength=100) is separate and unaffected.
applies: pkg/services/ngalert/state/historian annotation tag writing, when the annotation_tag DB column size changes
